name: intent-notes
description: Have the coding agent record what it changed and why — docstrings on the code, an immutable note for any change that is more than mechanical — and name a path's notes as it is read or edited

interface.shortDescription: Record why code changed and surface prior change notes
interface.longDescription: Intent Notes asks the coding agent to leave docstrings on what it changed and an immutable note on what the change was for -- a purely mechanical change needs none -- derives the branch's change set from git to list the paths no note records yet, and names the notes covering a path, with their titles, as the agent reads or edits it. It never blocks a tool or holds a turn.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $intent-notes to record the current branch change and its rationale.
